result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and a traffic signal. However, the environment is degraded by faded pavement markings, poor road surface quality, and a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible potholes and cracking in the roadway surface near the pedestrian crossing area create trip hazards and may cause vehicles to swerve.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Realignment
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a residential street with sidewalks and a marked but significantly faded zebra crosswalk. The presence of trolley tracks and severely degraded pavement creates tripping hazards and uneven surfaces for those crossing the street.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement and Tracks
hazards.description: The asphalt around the trolley tracks is heavily cracked and pitted, creating a significant tripping hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and middle ground within the roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra crossing markings are severely worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection limit the visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides near the crossing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pavement and Track Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the degraded asphalt and level the surface around the trolley tracks to eliminate tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical buffers like street trees or curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light poles on the corners

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt within the intersection and crosswalk area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and marked crosswalks, though the markings are significantly faded. The presence of embedded trolley tracks and a wide roadway width increases crossing complexity and exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending through the intersection

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground crossing the main street

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic without a refuge island.
